effect.name: GM Luma Radiance
effect.desc: Energy-preserving luminance aura with controllable threshold and color.
effect.shader: const vec3 L=vec3(0.2126,0.7152,0.0722);float pnkjRadianceEnergy(vec2 u){vec4 c=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(u,0.0,1.0));return max(dot(c.rgb,L)-threshold,0.0);} void main(){vec2 u=acScreenNorm;vec2 p=spread/max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));vec4 s=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,u);float a=pnkjRadianceEnergy(u)*0.2;a+=(pnkjRadianceEnergy(u+vec2(p.x,0.0))+pnkjRadianceEnergy(u-vec2(p.x,0.0))+pnkjRadianceEnergy(u+vec2(0.0,p.y))+pnkjRadianceEnergy(u-vec2(0.0,p.y)))*0.12;a+=(pnkjRadianceEnergy(u+p)+pnkjRadianceEnergy(u-p)+pnkjRadianceEnergy(u+vec2(p.x,-p.y))+pnkjRadianceEnergy(u+vec2(-p.x,p.y)))*0.08;gl_FragColor=vec4(s.rgb+radianceColor.rgb*a*gain,s.a);}
